taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-29 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 995.1 | 4.02 | 4.02
2 | 1300.6 | 35.56 | 39.58
3 | 381.3 | 12.04 | 51.62
4 | 1563.6 | 22.76 | 74.38
5 | 1611.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-29
Curve type: KHA-type
Aquifer depth: 39.58 - 51.62 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone identified in Layer 3. Ensure the borehole is screened within the 40m to 52m depth interval to intercept the potential aquifer.
